title: Java/Kotlin library published to Maven Central
appliesWhen: A JVM library published to Maven Central (through the Sonatype Central Portal) for others to depend on.
ask: Will this be published to Maven Central? Which groupId (and is the namespace verified), Maven or Gradle, and which Java versions are supported?

sources.title: Sonatype Central: Publishing with the Central Publishing Maven Plugin

guidance: Publish through the Central Portal; with Maven use org.sonatype.central:central-publishing-maven-plugin (0.12.0 at the time of checking) with publishingServerId matching a settings.xml server holding a Portal user token.
The groupId must be in a namespace verified on the Central Portal (a domain you control or io.github.<user>).
Every non-pom artifact needs -sources.jar and -javadoc.jar, every file a .asc GPG signature and .md5/.sha1 checksums; release versions cannot end in -SNAPSHOT.
The POM needs name, description, url, licenses, at least one developer and scm (connection, developerConnection, url).
Releases on Maven Central are permanent: fix a bad release with a new version.
Gradle builds: the gate commands are written for Maven; replace them with the Gradle equivalents (profile gate <id> --command "...").
Keep the signing key and Portal token in CI secrets; publish the public key to a keyserver so Central can verify signatures.

gates.title: POM metadata and coordinates meet Central requirements
gates.architecture: Record the groupId (verified namespace), artifactId, packaging, version scheme, licence, developers and SCM URLs.
acceptance: The POM has name, description, url, licenses, developers and scm (connection, developerConnection, url)
The groupId namespace is verified on the Central Portal and release versions do not end in -SNAPSHOT

gates.title: The build produces sources and javadoc jars
gates.setup: Bind maven-source-plugin (jar-no-fork) and maven-javadoc-plugin (jar) in the build; if they are in a release profile, add -P <profile> to the command.
gates.architecture: Record the Java release targeted, how sources and javadoc jars are built, and whether they are bound to the default build or a release profile.
acceptance: mvn verify succeeds and target/ contains the main, -sources and -javadoc jars

gates.title: Signed releases are published from CI through the Central Portal
gates.architecture: Record the release workflow: GPG signing (maven-gpg-plugin) with the key in CI secrets, the Portal user token, central-publishing-maven-plugin settings (autoPublish or manual release) and checksum generation.
acceptance: Every deployed file has a .asc signature verifiable with the published public key, and .md5/.sha1 checksums
The deployment passes Central Portal validation and the release is published from CI, not a developer machine

gates.title: Library licence and dependency licence compatibility need review
gates.architecture: Record the declared licence and the compile and runtime dependencies (and any shaded code) with their licences.
